title: 電子郵件
description: 撰寫與回覆工作郵件的用語

sentences.en: I'm writing to follow up on our previous conversation.
sentences.zh: 我寫信是要跟進我們之前的對話。

sentences.en: Please find the attached document for your review.
sentences.zh: 請查收附件文件以供您審閱。

sentences.en: I look forward to hearing from you soon.
sentences.zh: 期待您的早日回覆。

sentences.en: Thank you for your prompt reply.
sentences.zh: 感謝您的迅速回覆。

sentences.en: Could you please confirm the meeting time?
sentences.zh: 能否請您確認會議時間？

sentences.en: I apologize for the delayed response.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉延遲回覆。

sentences.en: Please let me know if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如有任何問題，請告訴我。

sentences.en: I'd like to schedule a call at your earliest convenience.
sentences.zh: 我想在您方便時安排一通電話。

sentences.en: As per our discussion, here is the updated plan.
sentences.zh: 根據我們的討論，這是更新後的計畫。

sentences.en: Could you kindly send me the latest version?
sentences.zh: 能否請您寄給我最新版本？

sentences.en: I'm CC'ing my manager on this email.
sentences.zh: 這封信我會副本給我的主管。

sentences.en: Please see the details below.
sentences.zh: 請見以下詳細內容。

sentences.en: I wanted to bring this matter to your attention.
sentences.zh: 我想提請您注意這件事。

sentences.en: Thank you for your cooperation.
sentences.zh: 感謝您的配合。

sentences.en: I hope this email finds you well.
sentences.zh: 希望您一切安好。

sentences.en: Would it be possible to extend the deadline?
sentences.zh: 是否可以延長截止日期？

sentences.en: I've attached the report for your reference.
sentences.zh: 我附上了報告供您參考。

sentences.en: Please don't hesitate to reach out if you need anything.
sentences.zh: 如果您需要任何協助，請隨時聯繫。

sentences.en: I'll get back to you by the end of the week.
sentences.zh: 我會在本週結束前回覆您。

sentences.en: Just a friendly reminder about tomorrow's deadline.
sentences.zh: 友善提醒您明天的截止日期。

sentences.en: Could you forward this to the relevant team?
sentences.zh: 能否請您轉寄給相關團隊？

sentences.en: I appreciate your assistance with this matter.
sentences.zh: 感謝您對此事的協助。

sentences.en: Regarding your inquiry, here is the information you requested.
sentences.zh: 關於您的詢問，以下是您要求的資訊。

sentences.en: Please acknowledge receipt of this email.
sentences.zh: 請確認收到此封郵件。

sentences.en: I'd appreciate it if you could reply by Friday.
sentences.zh: 如果您能在週五前回覆，我將不勝感激。

sentences.en: Sorry for any inconvenience this may cause.
sentences.zh: 對於造成的任何不便，深感抱歉。

sentences.en: Feel free to suggest an alternative time.
sentences.zh: 歡迎建議其他時間。

sentences.en: I'm available for a call anytime this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 今天下午任何時間我都可以通話。

sentences.en: Best regards.
sentences.zh: 祝好。

sentences.en: Looking forward to our collaboration.
sentences.zh: 期待我們的合作。
